about: The campaign world. Generated from `seed` by tools/worldgen (blueprint.js, generate.js), then hand-tuned by `edits`. Positions are [lon, lat] in degrees (1 map unit = 0.05 deg). Ports snap to the nearest coast within 3 deg of the given point. Rebuild the game data with: node tools/worldgen/build.js

pois.name: The Skarn Strait Wreck Fields
pois.text: Dozens of ships from both coalitions lie in the cold northern passages. Some still contain sealed technical archives and prototype weapons. The Halvards restrict access; everyone else tries to sneak in.

pois.name: Austral Barrier station
pois.text: Pre-war scientific outposts on the edge of the Howling Seas. Most are silent. A few still transmit on old frequencies.

pois.name: The Lost Squadron of the Central Hesperian
pois.text: In the final weeks of the war an entire Concord battle group vanished after reporting contact with an unknown force. No wreckage was ever confirmed. Both sides still search the area.

pois.name: The Throat Research Anchorage
pois.text: A heavily damaged Directorate research complex in the inner Sable Sea. Officially abandoned. Unofficially, signals still occasionally leave it.

pois.name: The Corvo Canal Zone
pois.text: Demilitarized on paper. In practice a nest of spies, smugglers, and deniable special forces. Whoever truly controls the Canal in the next war will control the movement of fleets between the Hesperian and the southern oceans.

pois.name: Austral Barrier station (east)
pois.text: Pre-war scientific outposts on the edge of the Howling Seas. Most are silent. A few still transmit on old frequencies.

concord.name: Hesperian Concord
concord.desc: Legacy maritime empire: the Hallandian naval compact that never stood down after the armistice.

directorate.desc: Continental successor state still fighting the unfinished war from the Vargan sounds, the Rime and the Sable Sea.

republic.name: Tarsene Free Republic
republic.desc: Revolutionary breakaway regime holding the Tarsene Gate to the Cradle Sea.

story.brief: Black Flag raiders are stalking Concord colliers off the Calder capes. Find the flotilla led by the destroyer Jackal and sink it.
A Directorate submarine pack is sinking tankers on the Halbrook convoy route. Bring sonar ships (destroyers or corvettes). Submerged boats stay invisible until a sonar ship gets close.
The Directorate destroyer Vigil carries a cipher machine and patrols the Wexmouth approaches. Sinking her gains nothing. Batter her until she strikes her colours, then take her as a prize.

story.title: Breaking the Strelsk Sounds
story.brief: A Directorate cruiser squadron under Admiral Orlov holds the Strelsk Sounds shut. Break it and the Vargan coast is open to Concord trade.
The battleship Iron Will has sortied from Strelsk with her screen. Sink her and Directorate sea power is broken for a generation.

commission.blurb: An old Destroyer and a Corvette under Hesperian Concord colours, based at Calder Roads. The Admiralty has work for you. The Directorate keeps the armistice, barely.

smuggler.blurb: A worn Freighter and a Torpedo Boat out of Port Saffron. Neutral with every flag, so every market is open to you, at least for now.

wolf.blurb: One war-surplus Submarine and a hand-picked crew at Halbrook. Strike unseen and slip away. The Concord pays well for Directorate tonnage.
